description: This Java source file defines the class AcknowledgementLabelNotDeclaredException, a custom exception used in the Eclipse Ditto project to indicate that an acknowledgement label was not declared for a session/connection. It includes methods for creating instances from labels or JSON objects, and a builder class for constructing instances.

classes.name: AcknowledgementLabelNotDeclaredException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception thrown when an acknowledgement label is not declared for a session/connection.

classes.name: AcknowledgementLabelNotDeclaredException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of AcknowledgementLabelNotDeclaredException.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an exception instance with a specific label and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers.
